_about: Verdicts on what tools/read_plan.py could not settle by itself. The reader re-reads
this on every run, so a decision survives regenerating the data; a click in the app
does not, until it is copied in here.
reject: a read that is wrong. Matched by number, within 120 px of the spot, and
dropped before anything is classified or applied.
place:  a room put where a person looking at the
scan says it is. Applied as source 'scan-accepted', and overrides any traced
point of the same number -- and outranks a confident read on WHERE the room is.
Every entry below was checked by eye against a crop of the scan (by Claude, 2026-10-09): 'why' says what it showed.
